The CAOS coverage guarantee applies to nonconformity scores that satisfy two structural properties: (i) symmetry with respect to permutations of the reference data, and (ii) monotonicity with respect to the inclusion of additional examples. Score functions that violate these conditions, such as scores involving parameters retrained on the augmented dataset, fall outside the scope of our theory. Although CAOS deliberately breaks score exchangeability by excluding the test point from the reference data, this does not compromise coverage.
